business_summary: Nitta Corporation engages in the provision of power transmission belts, conveyor belts and units, and other products in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, North America, South America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Belt and Rubber Products Business; Hose and Tube Product Business; Chemical Products Business; Other Industrial Products Business; Real Estate Business; and Management Guidance Business. It offers power transmission and conveyor belts, including PolySprint, Polybelt, and Super Endless belts; curve belt list; and conveyor units, such as curve, spiral, non-snaking, and junction conveyor systems. It also provides Hose and tube products comprising thermoplastic hoses and couplings, tubing and tube fittings, clean tube fittings, speed controllers and valves, and disconnect couplings; and industrial wipers and molded rubber products. In addition, the company offers air and chemical filters; filter casting and clean system equipment; bacteria decontamination equipment; particle and microorganism measuring instruments. Further, it provides mechatronics products, including automatic tool changers and interface units; Intelimer tapes; and RFID magnetic sheets. Additionally, the company offers SOFTmatics, a robot hand used for handling objects; and thermoplastic tubes, tubes and fittings for air brakes, and air spring. The company also engages in leasing land and buildings, and management consulting services; and offers polishing pads and slurry, and construction and waterproofing materials. It serves civil engineering and construction, automobile, logistic and transportation, environment and energy, industrial machinery, semiconductor, liquid crystal and electronic components, food, medicine, and healthcare industries. The company was formerly known as Nitta Belting Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nitta Corporation in 1982. The company was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

PolySprint, Polybelt 및 Super Endless 벨트를 포함한 동력 전달 및 컨베이어 벨트를 제공합니다. 커브 벨트 목록; 곡선형, 나선형형, 비구렁이형 및 접합형 컨베이어 시스템과 같은 컨베이어 장치 등이 있습니다. 또한 열가소성 호스 및 커플링, 튜브 및 튜브 피팅, 클린 튜브 피팅, 속도 컨트롤러 및 밸브, 분리 커플링으로 구성된 호스 및 튜브 제품도 제공합니다. 산업용 와이퍼, 고무성형제품 등이 있습니다. 또한 이 회사는 공기 및 화학 필터를 제공합니다. 필터 주조 및 청정 시스템 장비; 박테리아 오염 제거 장비; 입자 및 미생물 측정 장비. 또한 자동 공구 교환 장치 및 인터페이스 장치를 포함한 메카트로닉스 제품을 제공합니다. 인텔리머 테이프; RFID 마그네틱
